## `lathe`

```text
$ python -m lathe.cli --help
usage: lathe [-h] [--debug-traceback] [--strict-prompt-injection]
             {parse,normalize,fmt,schema,backends,shape-providers,completions,probe-providers,doctor,check,plan,materialize,build,probe-blender,export-blend,inspect-blend,render-eval,bridge,inspect,serve,render-fixture,bake-audit,library,surface-plan,surface-build,surface-validate,surface-repair,fit,adapt,assemble,reconstruct,test,bench,audit,explain,explain-fit,diff-asset,patch,ref,cache,diff,publish,snapshot,telemetry,asset-quality,scene,wonder}
             ...

Lathe 3D asset compiler/runtime

positional arguments:
  {parse,normalize,fmt,schema,backends,shape-providers,completions,probe-providers,doctor,check,plan,materialize,build,probe-blender,export-blend,inspect-blend,render-eval,bridge,inspect,serve,render-fixture,bake-audit,library,surface-plan,surface-build,surface-validate,surface-repair,fit,adapt,assemble,reconstruct,test,bench,audit,explain,explain-fit,diff-asset,patch,ref,cache,diff,publish,snapshot,telemetry,asset-quality,scene,wonder}
    parse               Parse a .lth file to raw AST JSON
    normalize           Normalize a .lth file to canonical JSON
    fmt                 Rewrite Lathe sources in canonical form
    schema              Emit the normalized AST JSON schema
    backends            List builtin backend contracts and stacks
    shape-providers     List available shape provider adapters
    completions         Emit static shell completion scripts
    probe-providers     Probe shape provider availability in the current runtime
    doctor              Inspect the local Lathe environment and backend/provider availability
    check               Run semantic checks
    plan                Emit the effective build plan for an asset or variant
    materialize         Materialize one asset or variant after uses and patches
    build               Execute the first runnable backend stack and package outputs
    probe-blender       Probe Blender availability and V1.3 execution capabilities
    export-blend        Report or copy the retained .blend artifact for a completed build
    inspect-blend       Inspect the retained V1.3 .blend artifact summary for a completed build
    render-eval         Build an asset and emit V1.3 render-eval evidence
    bridge              Operate on V1.3.1 Lathe-Blender bridge plans and diagnostics
    inspect             Inspect V1.3.1 evidence from a completed build
    serve               Serve a completed build's .glb via a local <model-viewer> page
    render-fixture      Report render-fixture evidence from a completed build
    bake-audit          Report bake evidence and missing bake diagnostics from a completed build
    library             Operate on V1.3 library bindings
    surface-plan        Explain V1.2 surface authoring for an asset
    surface-build       Run the V1.2 surface stage with required upstream prerequisites
    surface-validate    Evaluate only V1.2 surface outputs
    surface-repair      Attempt V1.2 zone-local surface repair
    fit                 Explain deterministic fit/reference inputs for an asset
    adapt               Build an asset in adapt mode
    assemble            Build an asset in assemble mode
    reconstruct         Build an asset in reconstruct mode
    test                Execute Lathe-defined source tests
    bench               Execute Lathe-defined source benchmarks
    audit               Run benchmark/style of workspace audit for the current Lathe repo
    explain             Explain why a build passed, failed, or selected a candidate
    explain-fit         Explain fit/reference/transfer inputs for a completed build
    diff-asset          Diff two materialized assets
    patch               Apply a semantic patch operation and emit normalized JSON
    ref                 Operate on @lathe[...] semantic references (Phase 1: non-geometric)
    cache               Inspect, clean, and warm the Lathe build cache
    diff                Compare two .lathe_snapshot.json files (RPT-5)
    publish             Publish a completed build to a configured target
    snapshot            Emit a canonical hash-based snapshot for a completed build
    telemetry           Manage opt-in anonymous build-ping telemetry
    asset-quality       Validate and certify Phase 14 asset-quality example fixtures
    scene               Operate on scene packages and World Memory
    wonder              Validate Wonder-readiness JSON contracts

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --debug-traceback     Show Python tracebacks for unexpected CLI failures. Also settable via
                        LATHE_DEBUG_TRACEBACK=1.
  --strict-prompt-injection
                        SEC-8: promote prompt-injection scanner warnings (L7001-L7005) to errors.
                        Also settable via LATHE_STRICT_PROMPT_INJECTION=1.
```

## `lathe fmt`

```text
$ python -m lathe.cli fmt --help
usage: lathe fmt [-h] [--check] [--dry-run] [--stdout] [files ...]

Rewrite Lathe sources in canonical form. By default, files are rewritten in place; use --check to
report without writing, --dry-run to print a unified diff, or --stdout to read a single file (or
stdin) and write the canonical form to stdout.

positional arguments:
  files       Files or glob patterns (default: examples/*.lth)

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --check     Don't write; exit non-zero if any file would change
  --dry-run   Print a unified diff without writing
  --stdout    Read a single file (or stdin) and write canonical output to stdout
```

## `lathe build`

```text
$ python -m lathe.cli build --help
usage: lathe build [-h] [--out OUT] [--runtime-config RUNTIME_CONFIG]
                   [--shape-provider SHAPE_PROVIDER] [--strict] [--strict-shape-provider]
                   [--allow-fallback] [--codex-imagegen {auto,fallback,emit,consume}]
                   [--execution-profile EXECUTION_PROFILE] [--publish PUBLISH]
                   [--report {terminal,html,json}] [--deterministic]
                   file name

Execute the first runnable backend stack and package outputs. Exit codes: 0 = ok; 1 = build or
provider error (including 'provider_fallback_blocked' under strict shape-provider mode); 2 = CLI
usage error.

positional arguments:
  file
  name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT             Output directory root (default: ./dist)
  --runtime-config RUNTIME_CONFIG
                        Optional runtime config JSON file
  --shape-provider SHAPE_PROVIDER
                        Override the shape provider adapter (for example: hunyuan2_1_http or
                        vggt_local)
  --strict              Fail instead of falling back when the selected shape provider is
                        unavailable or errors.
  --strict-shape-provider
                        [DEPRECATED] Back-compat alias: fail instead of falling back when the
                        selected shape provider is unavailable or errors. Emits a
                        DeprecationWarning; use --strict (V0.2+) or set shape.strict=true in
                        runtime_config.
  --allow-fallback      BL-37 (Plan 08 Phase 8): explicitly opt into the legacy 'fall back to
                        reference_conditioned on learned-provider error' behavior, silencing the
                        V0.1.x DeprecationWarning. In V0.2 this becomes the sole non-strict opt-
                        out.
  --codex-imagegen {auto,fallback,emit,consume}
                        Codex-operated imagegen handoff mode for V1.2 surfaces
  --execution-profile EXECUTION_PROFILE
                        Override the resolved V1.3 execution profile
  --publish PUBLISH     BL-31 (Plan 08 Phase 1): after a successful build, publish the output via
                        the named driver (e.g. local_fs, s3, supabase, git_lfs). Driver-specific
                        settings come from --runtime-config.
  --report {terminal,html,json}
                        BL-36 (Plan 08 Phase 6): select the build-report output style. Default:
                        'terminal' if stdout is a TTY, else 'json'. 'html' also writes report.html
                        next to build_report.json.
  --deterministic       RPT-3 (V0.2 E4): emit reports with zeroed timestamps, forward-slash paths,
                        collapsed $HOME, runtime_ms rounded to the nearest ms, and diagnostics
                        sorted by code. Two cache-cleared builds produce byte-identical JSON
                        reports.
```

## `lathe diff`

```text
$ python -m lathe.cli diff --help
usage: lathe diff [-h] [--json] [--verbose] snapshot_a snapshot_b

RPT-5 (V0.2): structural diff between two snapshot sidecars emitted by ``lathe snapshot`` (RPT-4).
Exits 0 on no drift, 1 on drift, 2 on usage error. Distinct from the ``ref diff`` sub-subcommand
which diffs selector manifests.

positional arguments:
  snapshot_a  First snapshot JSON (baseline)
  snapshot_b  Second snapshot JSON (candidate)

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      Emit machine-readable JSON
  --verbose   Include stages with matching hashes in the output
```

```text
$ python -m lathe.cli publish --help
usage: lathe publish [-h] [--target TARGET] [--runtime-config RUNTIME_CONFIG]
                     [--signing-key SIGNING_KEY] [--target-dir TARGET_DIR] [--bucket BUCKET]
                     [--asset ASSET] [--version VERSION] [--sign] [--signer-id SIGNER_ID]
                     [--verify RECEIPT]
                     [build_dir]

Publish artifacts + signed manifest from a completed build directory. Drivers: local_fs, s3,
supabase, git_lfs. Target configuration comes from --runtime-config (runtime_config.publish.*)
with --target overriding.

positional arguments:
  build_dir             Directory produced by `lathe build --out`

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --target TARGET       Publish target id (e.g. local_fs, s3)
  --runtime-config RUNTIME_CONFIG
                        Optional runtime config JSON file
  --signing-key SIGNING_KEY
                        ed25519 private key path (overrides runtime_config)
  --target-dir TARGET_DIR
                        LocalFSDriver destination directory
  --bucket BUCKET       S3 / Supabase bucket override
  --asset ASSET         Asset name override
  --version VERSION     Asset version override
  --sign                SEC-NEW-2: emit a signed reproducibility_receipt.json next to the
                        manifest.
  --signer-id SIGNER_ID
                        Signer identity recorded in the reproducibility receipt.
  --verify RECEIPT      SEC-NEW-2: verify an existing reproducibility_receipt.json and exit.
```

Operate on folder-based Scene Packages and World Memory JSON contracts.

  {check,plan,materialize,build,render,export,validate,bench,style-pack,layout,camera-lighting,assemble,roblox-manifest,roblox-export,patch,branch,diff,merge,rollback,inspect-render,propose-repairs,repair,curiosity,expand-anchor,scene-graph-to-source,source-to-scene-graph,package,memory}
    check               Run schema and semantic checks for a Scene Graph JSON file
    plan                Emit a deterministic Scene Plan for a Scene Graph JSON file
    materialize         Lower a Scene Graph into generated Lathe asset source files
    build               Build a deterministic offline Scene Package preview
    render              Render deterministic proxy PNG passes for a Scene Graph
    export              Export deterministic proxy scene artifacts
    validate            Run scene quality validators for a Scene Graph JSON file
    bench               Emit a deterministic Wonder Scene Benchmark Report
    style-pack          Extract and validate a Style Pack from a Scene Graph
    layout              Emit deterministic Layout Plan JSON for a Scene Graph
    camera-lighting     Emit deterministic camera/lighting plan JSON
    assemble            Emit deterministic Scene Assembly IR for a Scene Graph
    roblox-manifest     Emit a Roblox profile validation manifest
    roblox-export       Export a Roblox asset-kit GLB folder
    patch               Apply a Scene Patch JSON file to a Scene Graph JSON file
    branch              Create deterministic scene branch/version metadata
    diff                Diff two Scene Graph JSON files
    merge               Merge non-overlapping Scene Graph changes
    rollback            Rollback a Scene Graph using hash-guarded Scene History
    inspect-render      Validate Render Inspection JSON against a scene
    propose-repairs     Convert Render Inspection JSON to Scene Patch proposals
    repair              Run deterministic offline repair proposals
    curiosity           Summarize curiosity anchors as deterministic cards
    expand-anchor       Expand a curiosity anchor option into a Scene Graph copy
    scene-graph-to-source
                        Convert Scene Graph JSON into generated scene source
    source-to-scene-graph
                        Extract Scene Graph JSON from generated scene source
    package             Inspect, initialize, and validate scene packages
    memory              Inspect and append World Memory events

options:
